item.title: Kim Jae Joong is bringing his 'GALAXY 1986' fan concert to Singapore this March
item.description: Kim Jae Joong is finally landing in Singapore for his first-ever solo concert in the city thanks to Sliding Doors Entertainment — and it’s going to be cosmic. The multi-hyphenate K-pop icon is set to perform on 28 March at Arena @ EXPO as part of his 2026 J-Party Asia Tour Fan Concert, GALAXY 1986. The show celebrates his 23-year artistic journey and promises a night of emotional resonance, star-powered performances, and deep fan connection. item.title: New indie cinema Filmhouse is set to open at The Projector’s former Golden Mile Tower space
item.description: Singapore’s independent cinema scene is getting a new lease of life with Filmhouse, a new arthouse venue set to open at the former home of The Projector at Golden Mile Tower. The new cinema takes over the three-screen space previously occupied by The Projector, which ceased operations last August after nearly a decade as one of Singapore’s most recognisable indie film hubs. item.title: XG redefine their name from Xtraordinary Girls to Xtraordinary Genes in bold new chapter
item.description: XG are entering their next chapter — and they’re bringing a whole new meaning with them. On 12 January, the hip-hop/R&B powerhouse announced an evolution in their name, shifting from Xtraordinary Girls to Xtraordinary Genes. The update isn’t just cosmetic — it marks a powerful moment of growth for the group, all of whom have now stepped into their 20s, signalling a fresh era of creative and personal exploration. item.title: BoA & SM Entertainment part ways after 25 years marking a new chapter for the K-pop legend
item.description: After more than two decades together, BoA and SM Entertainment have officially parted ways. SM Entertainment announced on 12 January that BoA’s exclusive contract with the company concluded on 31 December, following thorough discussions between both parties.
